employer_specifics: Role mandate: 'help build, implement, and deploy agentic platforms within client environments' — operationalising LLM-powered agents across products, processes and teams, integrated with existing enterprise systems (APIs, data platforms, cloud services).

Listing asks for multi-agent systems with tool use, workflow orchestration, memory and decision-making; RAG pipelines over enterprise data; LLM orchestration frameworks named are LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen; Python is the core language, with Kubernetes deployment expected.
Nearform: ~500 people across 20+ countries, open-source heritage (Node.js ecosystem), clients named include Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media O2 and Walmart.
Interview process: 30-min talent call, 1-hour LIVE Python coding challenge over Zoom screen-share, 45-min hiring-manager interview, possible extra client interview depending on project.
verify.red_flags: (1) Pay: stated range "starts from £75,000" — below the £80k floor at the bottom, and the scout's £95k ceiling is not in the listing; no upper bound given, so it is negotiable but unverified. Phil has no formal software-engineering employment history; the coding test is the real gate. (3) "Frequent" travel to European client sites is a required yes/no screening question despite remote framing. (4) Posting has been open since 4 Feb 2026 (6+ months, refreshed 11 Aug) — may be an evergreen/pipeline requisition rather than a single open seat. (5) Possible public-sector client exposure on specific engagements (private employer, so not excluded).
verify.decision_reason: Live, direct private-sector employer, Greenhouse form reachable with no account and all fields/options captured. But three things only Phil can decide: (a) whether to apply into a band that starts at £75k (select '£80,000 – £90,000' or higher, or 'Prefer to discuss') given his £80k floor; (b) whether he will commit to 'frequent' European client-site travel on the required screener; (c) whether he wants to sit a 1-hour live Python coding challenge for a role specified as 8+ years Senior Engineer with Kubernetes — a materially harder engineering bar than the scout's 5/5 fit implied. If he says yes to all three, the application can be submitted with CV + LinkedIn + cover note without any login.

pack.cover_note: Since March 2025 I have been shipping autonomous agents into production for paying businesses through Blue Canvas AI, not running chatbot pilots. The core of that is Albie, a 24/7 multi-channel operator built on the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK: inbox, Apollo and Zoho campaigns, proposals, coding and scheduled tasks with persistent memory across WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord. My own company runs on it daily. Nearform's mandate to build and deploy agentic platforms inside client environments, integrated with existing APIs, data platforms and cloud services, is the work I already do across six live engagements, including The Wall Group, where AI workflow integration lifted net profit 17% year on year. Stack: Python, TypeScript, multi-agent orchestration, tool use, RAG, eval design. Eighteen years of commercial leadership before that means I can hold the client conversation as well as the code. Based in Derry, UK right to work, remote with European travel.
